# IMDb

> > The world's most popular and authoritative source for movie, TV, and celebrity content, featuring comprehensive databases of films, television shows, cast and crew information, ratings, reviews, and entertainment industry events.

IMDb (Internet Movie Database) provides extensive catalogs organized by genres, subgenres, and interests, including horror categories (psychological horror, vampire horror), anime subgenres (shōnen, action anime), and epic action films. The platform tracks trending titles, hosts information about major film festivals and award ceremonies, and serves as the primary reference for entertainment industry professionals and fans worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Horror subgenres
- Shōnen anime
- Japanese animation
- Trending movies
- Film festivals and awards
- Psychological horror
- Vampire horror
- Action epic films
- Anime movies and TV shows
- Popular movie lists
- Genre categorization
- Cast and crew databases
- Film ratings and reviews
- Entertainment industry events

## Events & Industry

- [All events](https://m.imdb.com/event/all/?ref_=int_nv_menu): Comprehensive directory of film festivals and award ceremonies

## Horror Categories

- [Horror - IMDb](https://m.imdb.com/interest/in0000112/?ref_=ints_cat_12_in_i_5): Horror genre collection featuring fear and suspense-driven content
- [Psychological Horror - IMDb](https://m.imdb.com/interest/in0000114/?ref_=ints_cat_12_in_i_7): Psychological horror subgenre collection with tension-driven content
- [Vampire Horror - IMDb](https://m.imdb.com/interest/in0000119/?ref_=int_sim_in_i_11): Vampire horror subgenre catalog with supernatural bloodsucker content

## Anime & Animation

- [Shōnen - IMDb](https://m.imdb.com/interest/in0000206/?ref_=int_sim_in_in_i_7): Shōnen anime subgenre catalog featuring action-packed young male content

## Action & Epic Films

- [Action Epic - IMDb](https://m.imdb.com/interest/in0000002/?ref_=int_sim_in_i_2): Action epic subgenre catalog featuring grand-scale heroic narratives
